sections.title: Theft (चोरी)
legal_ingredients: Taken out of the possession of any person
Moved in order to such taking

victim: Right to lodge an FIR immediately under Section 173 BNSS
Right to receive a free copy of the FIR
accused: Right to know the grounds of arrest
Right to be produced before a Magistrate within 24 hours

police_powers: Power to arrest without warrant (Cognizable offense)
Power to seize stolen property as evidence
police_limits: Must record valid reasons for arrest under Section 35 BNSS
Cannot use unnecessary force or detention beyond 24 hours without court order

immediate_lawful_remedies: Visit nearest police station or submit Zero FIR
If police refuse FIR, send written complaint to SP/DCP under Section 173(4) BNSS
File application before Judicial Magistrate under Section 175(3) BNSS

sections.title: Criminal Intimidation (आपराधिक धमकी)
legal_ingredients: Threatening another person with injury to person, reputation, or property
Intent to cause alarm to that person
Intent to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally bound to do

victim: Right to register a Non-Cognizable Report (NCR) under Section 174 BNSS
Right to approach the Magistrate directly for direction to investigate
accused: Cannot be arrested by police without a warrant from a Magistrate
Right to bail as a matter of right upon presentation

police_limits: Cannot investigate or arrest without specific Magistrate order under Section 174(2) BNSS

immediate_lawful_remedies: File NCR at the local police station
Preserve evidence (call recordings, WhatsApp screenshots, CCTV footage)
Approach Magistrate under Section 174(2) BNSS for investigation order
